title: Hand the cluster to Git
scenario: "From today nobody deploys with kubectl. Whatever is in Git is what runs, and the deploy is only done when the smoke test says so." — Head of Platform
mission: Bootstrap Argo CD, render the platform values through a PR, ship v1.0.0 and get both environments Synced and Healthy with a passing PostSync smoke.
objectives: Use a PostSync hook as the deploy gate

prerequisites.notes: GITOPS_PR_TOKEN secret set (deploy PRs need it to trigger checks).

cost: Cluster running cost; ACR Basic ≈ US$0.17/day.

steps.title: Render values
steps.detail: Generate platform.values.yaml from Terraform outputs and open a PR.

steps.title: Build v1.0.0
steps.detail: First images by hand, then a tags PR.

steps.title: Bootstrap
steps.detail: Install Argo CD and the root app.

steps.title: Wait for the gate
steps.detail: The PostSync smoke can take up to 7 minutes.

steps.title: Break it
steps.detail: Scale prod web to 0 by hand and watch Argo CD revert it (self-heal).

criteria.text: All Argo CD applications are Synced and Healthy
portal-dev smoke job logged SMOKE OK version=v1.0.0
portal-prod smoke job logged SMOKE OK version=v1.0.0

expectedResult: Git is the only way to change the cluster.
recovery: Sync Failed with a smoke error: read the job log first (version mismatch vs database path vs web tier).
dont: Do not kubectl apply or edit the app
Do not use kubectl rollout undo
hints: The root application points at gitops/apps.
A PostSync hook runs after every successful sync; its failure fails the operation.
selfHeal: true in the Application spec reverts manual changes.

interview.question: What is GitOps, and how is it different from a pipeline that runs kubectl apply?
followUps: Pull vs push: which has the smaller credential surface?

debrief: Pull-based GitOps keeps cluster credentials inside the cluster; CI only writes to Git. The PostSync smoke turns "pods are running" into "the release is live". Self-heal makes manual drift short-lived and visible.

checker.plan: Read-only: kubectl get applications -n argocd -o json; kubectl logs job/customer-portal-smoke in both namespaces.

validation.notes: Checker not implemented yet; needs a running cluster.
